customer.business: Edurance (AI-powered adaptive learning for school students, introduced through the child's school)
customer.target: Parents in Hyderabad and Secunderabad whose child (Class 4 to 10) attends a private school that is piloting Edurance

segments.name: Parent at a budget private school (fees roughly ₹25k-60k a year)
Parent at a mid-fee private school (fees roughly ₹60k-1.5L a year)
Parent at a premium or international-curriculum school

behaviours.name: Tuition-first
behaviours.how: Already pays a local tuition teacher or coaching centre and trusts in-person help more than apps.

behaviours.name: Marks-focused
behaviours.how: Judges everything by exam marks and rank; buys whatever the school or other parents say improves scores.

behaviours.name: Follows the school
behaviours.how: Pays for what the school recommends, rarely researches alternatives.

behaviours.name: Screen-time worrier
behaviours.how: Limits the child's phone and tablet use and is wary of anything that adds more.

behaviours.name: Burned by an edtech app
behaviours.how: Paid for a big-brand learning app before; the child stopped using it within weeks.

behaviours.name: Price-careful
behaviours.how: Counts every recurring expense, especially with more than one child in school.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Uses ChatGPT or YouTube to help the child already and likes trying new tools.

objections: My child already has tuition; this is one more thing
Will my child actually use it after the first week?
AI can give wrong answers; who checks what my child is taught?
More screen time is the last thing my child needs
Free apps and YouTube already do this
The school should pay for this, not me
I don't want my child's data going to some AI company
Will it match my child's syllabus and exams?
habits: your child shares one smartphone with you in the evenings
you check homework on the school WhatsApp group most nights
your child goes to tuition three evenings a week
you work long hours and your parents help with the children
a relative's child is in the same school

pitch:
Your child's school is piloting Edurance, an AI learning app, for your child's class this term.
In week 1 your child took a short diagnostic test in class. You have received a free report showing which topics they have mastered and which they are behind on.
Edurance gives your child a personal learning path for those gaps, explanations they can read or listen to, and practice that adjusts to their level. It works in a web browser on a phone, tablet or computer. You see progress each week in a parent view.
To continue after the free pilot: ₹299 per month, paid by you to Edurance. Cancel any time.
